entries.description: Operator set pathAwareCritique: advisory.
Registered session 1 via start_session (copilot / claude-opus-5 / high); read the preload, the 2026-08-04 proposal doc SS2-SS11, and Set 110 operator-notes (2026-08-05 sections).

Enforced the bounded totals in verify_session: evaluate_phase_bound + count_phase_family_rounds refuse a 3rd discovery-family pass, 3rd remediation-review cycle, or 3rd classic round before any metered call, unless --operator-authorized-round carries a non-empty operator attestation (appended to sN-round-authorizations.jsonl, written before the call, added to WORK_DIFF_SET_BOOKKEEPING).
Varied the discovery fan-out framing: per-call spec-conformance / failure-scenario lenses, per-call prompts and per-call evidence stamps, discoveryLens recorded in the merged envelope.

Wired the severity-gated stop into the exit path: a Minor-only round is named, counted, told not to re-round, and offered only the close_session command; a clean round says VERIFIED -- no findings. At-bound blocking rounds no longer print a re-run command the CLI would refuse.
Added 22 tests across TestEnforcedBounds / TestDiscoveryLenses / TestMinorOnlyStop; updated the two pre-existing tests whose scenarios the new behavior changes.

Verification was transport-blocked: cli_transport.py hardcoded a 300s total dispatch ceiling with no config/env path, and a full session-verification bundle (~116KB over the Set 104 file handoff) could not complete inside it (two total-timeout dispatches, nothing written; a trivial prompt returned in 13s). Stopped to the operator rather than self-authorizing; operator chose option A. Added transports.copilot-cli.timeouts (spawn/first_byte/total), default-preserving, validated at load (unknown keys, non-numeric, non-positive, bool, and the spawn<first_byte<total ordering all refused), wired through __init__.py, set total_seconds: 1200, plus 6 tests.

Discovery round 2 (both lenses) + supplementary round 3. Both discovery lenses independently reported the undisclosed operator-authorized transport scope extension (Major); supplementary reported, with a reproduction, that a clean supplementary round consumes a discovery pass but writes no envelope, so a third pass was accepted unauthorized (Major).

Remediation round 1. L1/L2: disclosed the operator-authorized scope extension in s1-conventions.md with the decision trail and trade-off; CHANGELOG now carries the fourth (Set 111 S1) entry. L3: replaced the authorization-only file with ONE append-only round ledger sN-rounds.jsonl carrying both the pre-call operator-authorization and the post-call round-completed record (phase/verdict/blocking/endedLoop); count_phase_family_rounds now unions ledger records (endedLoop false) with envelopes by round number, so pre-ledger sessions keep enforcement and no round double-counts; tolerant reader survives a torn line; WORK_DIFF_SET_BOOKKEEPING renamed to s*-rounds.jsonl. Baseline discrimination proven: the reproduction test fails pre-fix (EXIT_BLOCKING, third pass routed) and passes fixed.

Remediation-review round 4 on the fix delta: VERIFIED, 0 blocking, fix verdicts 1 accepted + 1 accepted-with-modification + 1 duplicate-of. One nit (a stale sN-round-authorizations.jsonl echo in s1-conventions.md) fixed in the same pass per L-065-1; the earlier activity-log entry describing the superseded design is left as the historical record it is.

Registered session 2 via start_session (copilot / claude-opus-5 / high, provider anthropic). Read the preload (constitution, project-guidance, lessons-learned, AGENTS.md), the spec, and proposal SS5/SS6/SS9. Recorded the operator notes (2026-08-07) in operator-notes.md: unaccounted verification work is treated as third-party, and two Work Explorer context-menu convenience items are logged as future-set candidates.

Extended the verifier envelope with the acceptance block: verification.md gains per-Issue Acceptance criterion / Acceptance expectation lines plus a Writing an acceptance criterion section (template pin bumped to session-verification-v4 with its new pinned hash); verification._parse_acceptance parses executable (backticked command + exit/output expectation) vs judgment forms tolerantly; docs/session-issues.schema.json + session-issues-schema.md document the optional per-issue acceptance object.

Built ai_router/acceptance_harness.py: runs each UNCHANGED criterion against the round discoveryBaselineTree (pre-fix) and a fresh working-tree snapshot (fixed). Auto-closes ONLY on fails-before AND passes-after. Vacuous (passes pre-fix), still-failing, test-asset-modified, criterion-changed (contract hash covers command + expectations), refused-unsafe (shell operators), judgment, no-criterion and error all stay judgment-based. Results written to sN-acceptance-round-<M>.json.

Containment: both runs happen in disposable git worktrees checked out from captured tree objects via commit-tree, never the live working tree; no shell (metacharacters refused, not interpreted); credential-stripped environment with DABBLER_NO_ROUTER=1; wall-clock timeout; cleanup on every path including errors.

Retained exactly one remediation-review: verify_session.assemble_acceptance_block renders criteria-closed findings with both runs evidence and non-closing criteria with their reason, keyed by ledger ids from the new single-source blocking_ledger_id_map; the phase framing now directs attention to what the fixes BROKE and what the criteria MISSED. Fix-verdict coverage is unchanged (Set 096 S2 round-11 operator decision).

OPERATOR-AUTHORIZED SCOPE EXTENSION (2026-08-07): absence of provider API keys must never warn unless a direct-API dispatch is attempted. load_config gains require_api_keys (default False) and the validation moved to the named config.validate_provider_api_keys; ai_router.__init__._init() (the dispatch entry) passes require_api_keys=True; copilot-cli stays exempt inside the validator; providers.call_model still raises at the true point of use. Root-fixed the two drift-guard tests Session 1 had recorded as pre-existing environmental failures. Docs (quick-start, constitution Step 0, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md) now present Direct APIs and Copilot CLI side by side. Also recorded a Set 112 note to relabel the two transports in user-facing surfaces (new labels, same config values).

Root-fixed the second environmental class Session 1 had excused: 14 tests in test_pull_verifier (6), test_routing_exclusion_integrity (6) and test_orchestrator_identity (2) fake the DIRECT-API seam but loaded the seat config, so on this copilot-cli seat route() sailed past the fakes into the real CLI and hung up to 20 min each (S1 raised the ceiling to 1200s). Two shared conftest fixtures -- placeholder_provider_keys and direct_api_transport (a copy of the SHIPPED api-pinned router-config.yaml in a scratch dir with no local-overrides beside it) -- make them seat-independent. 115 passed in 17s and 148 passed/3 skipped in 18s.
Full run of record after the last code change, NOTHING deselected: 3,563 passed / 0 failed / 10 skipped in 15m36s. First fully clean full run on this machine in the set.

Routed cross-provider verification, anthropic excluded, verifier gpt-5.5. Discovery round 1 (K=2, lenses spec-conformance + failure-scenario): ISSUES_FOUND, 5 blocking. Supplementary round 2: ISSUES_FOUND, 3 blocking. 8 findings, 6 distinct defects (2 cross-lens duplicate pairs). Both discovery passes now spent.

REMEDIATION ROUND 1 INCOMPLETE -- operator ended the working window. Fixed: broad test-runner/directory scope invalidation (is_test_runner, criterion_scopes, changed_paths_between, modified_test_assets_in_scope); .venv/bare-python interpreter rewrite (resolve_interpreter); shell/fetch program denylist. Built but NOT wired: raw_artifact_criteria + _call_key + OUTCOME_CRITERION_UNBOUND for the first-run-edit hole. NOT started: per-criterion worktree isolation, output evidence in the review block, correcting the over-claimed no-network/no-credentials wording (needs template v5). Full handoff in s2-remediation-round-1.md. Harness suite 61 passed.

Remediated all 8 blocking findings (6 distinct defects; 2 cross-lens duplicate pairs): raw-artifact criterion binding (first-run edits), scope-based test-asset invalidation, per-criterion disposable worktrees, venv/bare-python interpreter substitution, output evidence in the review block, and honest containment wording (template v5) plus a shell/fetch denylist. 3 tests named by the verifier own criteria written under exactly those names.

Remediation-review cycle 1 (round 3): 6 accepted, 1 duplicate-of, 1 REJECTED -- file-scoped pytest ignored conftest/fixture loading. Fixed with an end-to-end reproduction. Cycle 2 (round 4): 7 accepted, 1 duplicate-of, 1 REJECTED -- pytest ./ scoped to the literal dot. Fixed with an end-to-end reproduction. BOUND REACHED (2 of 2 cycles): stopping to the operator for adjudication rather than opening a third round. Full suite 3,584 passed / 0 failed / 10 skipped.

Dogfooded the harness on this session own findings, both rounds: 0 of 8 auto-closed. 5 criteria were judgment-form (verifier choice); all 3 executable ones named tests the remediation had to write, so test-asset-modified fired on its own author -- the guard working as designed. Recorded in the sidecar as the first live measurement of Proposal B yield (proposal SS10 Q4) for Session 4 to weigh.

Registered session 3 via start_session (copilot / claude-opus-5 / high, anthropic). Read the preload (constitution, project-guidance, lessons-learned, AGENTS.md), the spec, proposal SS11 decision-rights bullet, operator-notes.md, and S2 disposition. copilot_preflight OK. decision-review-queue.jsonl absent - nothing to triage.

Confirmed S1 (enforced bounds, varied lenses, severity-gated stop) and S2 (acceptance harness, envelope acceptance block, retained remediation-review) Creates/Touches exist on disk. S2 owed residual noted as this session first item: the close-backstop round 9 (stale acceptance evidence) and round 10 (baseline-mismatch) fixes carry tests but no routed cross-provider verdict.

Registered session 3 via start_session (copilot / claude-opus-5 / high, anthropic). Read the preload (constitution, project-guidance, lessons-learned, AGENTS.md), the spec, proposal Section 11 decision-rights bullet, operator-notes.md, and the S2 disposition. copilot_preflight OK. decision-review-queue.jsonl absent - nothing to triage.

Confirmed S1 (enforced bounds, varied discovery lenses, severity-gated stop) and S2 (acceptance harness, envelope acceptance block, retained remediation-review) Creates/Touches exist on disk. S2 owed residual taken as this session's first item: the close-backstop round 9 (stale acceptance evidence) and round 10 (baseline-mismatch) fixes carry executable regression tests and a green suite but no routed cross-provider verdict.

Canonized the decision-rights rubric in docs/ai-led-session-workflow.md as a new 'Decision rights - the rubric' section: route by AUTHORITY not judgment load; four human-required classes (external-consequence, value-trade-off, accountability-sign-off, verification-reduction) with the carve-out checked first; six ordered tiebreaks (goal-over-letter, prefer-reversible, simpler-code, defer-to-existing-gate, cross-provider-consensus, escalate-to-human); the human as auditor, not gate. The old human-only vs consensus-eligible split is REPLACED - decision-time consensus is now tiebreak 5 of the one rubric, and its category list is re-labelled a cost control.

Built ai_router/decision_journal.py - the blessed writer for a per-set decisions.jsonl. Records question, decision, authority, the rubric line that fired, options considered (each with consequence and reversibility), overall reversibility, declared verification_effect, and uat_decide for the S4 UAT Decide section. CLI: --rubric, --session-set-dir, --uat-decide-only, --append-json (exit 5 = refused). Added decisions.jsonl to verification_stamp.WORK_DIFF_SET_BOOKKEEPING so journaling a post-round adjudication cannot stale that round's evidence.

Added the canonical 'Education-mode briefs' section to docs/ai-led-session-workflow.md: the required five-part format for ANY operator stop (where the set stands / the question in one sentence / options with consequences / recommendation with confidence / the default on no answer), a worked example, batch-do-not-trickle, and do-not-argue-an-answer-down. Pointers added to docs/session-constitution.md (with the per-step table row) and to AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md / GEMINI.md.

Enforced the verification-reduction carve-out structurally: record_decision() refuses a verification_effect='reduces' record under authority='ai' (VerificationReductionRefused, a refusal to WRITE - no partial line), and the operator's own record requires a non-empty operator_attestation. The mandatory no-default verification_effect field is the primary control; the text screen behind it is one verb-near-noun proximity rule that can only ever escalate, deliberately not a phrase list (S2's six-round lesson). Updated router-config.yaml's delegation.decision_consensus comments to match.

ai_router/tests/test_decision_journal.py: 56 tests covering the journal round-trip (every rubric field, append order, one-bad-line tolerance, UAT filter, extras that cannot shadow), authority routing (each human class, carve-out named first, tiebreak order), the carve-out (self-authorization refused with nothing written, an existing journal not truncated, operator path with and without attestation), the escalate-only screen (spellings a phrase list would miss, ordinary engineering wording left alone, and the proof that a wording the screen misses is still caught by the declaration), field validation, the bookkeeping registration, and the CLI.

Dogfooded the journal on this session's own five judgment-shaped calls, written through the blessed writer to decisions.jsonl: the bookkeeping placement (defer-to-existing-gate), the declaration-over-classifier carve-out design (simpler-code), folding consensus into the rubric (goal-over-letter), cutting AGENTS.md prose rather than raising its ceiling (prefer-reversible), and discharging S2's owed residual through this session's own routed round (defer-to-existing-gate).
Registered session 4 (copilot/anthropic/claude-opus-5/high); copilot_preflight OK; preload read.
Confirmed S1-S3 Creates/Touches on disk: verify_session bounds, acceptance_harness, decision_journal, decisions.jsonl all present. Reviewed S3 disposition carry-forwards.
Shipped ai_router/spec_admission.py + authoring.max_steps_per_session=5. Threshold MEASURED from 172 v4 sessions: 6+ steps doubles median (42->84 min), triples p90, 10%->28% over 2h. 26 tests.
Shipped ai_router/run_of_record.py (content-digest freshness) + check_test_run_fresh close gate. Reproduces and refuses the 110 S3 stale-run pattern. 34+16 tests.
Shipped disposition.uat block + check_uat_walk_recorded. requiresUAT session closes only with a walk or an attested waiver.

Shipped npm run walk: scripts/stage-walk.js + shared scripts/vscode-launch.js (single definition of binary discovery + isolation flags, pinned against electronLaunch.ts by test). DABBLER_WALK=1 gates a self-reveal of the view in activate(). 14 mocha tests.

Pinned all 31 workflow uses: refs to 40-char SHAs (incl. the pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish moving BRANCH on the PyPI path); converged the stray setup-python@v4/@v5 on v5.6.0. Added .github/dependabot.yml as the bump path and a drift_guard actions-sha-pinned check, proven in both directions. 51 drift tests pass.

Authored s4-uat-walk.md in the new format (Look 5 + Decide 3). Every Look command pre-verified by automation before offering to the human. Decide section carries the batched education-mode brief: D1 artifact table, D2 admission bar, D3 close-backstop bound (operator-held hard carve-out).
ai_router/CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased]: four Set 111 S4 entries. Publish stays operator-gated.

Artifact-necessity evidence assembled from the code: sN-conventions.md has NO machine reader; ai-assignment.md parser is orphaned (UI removed Set 048 S3, accordion retired Set 034); change-log.md is load-bearing in ~15 sites + a close gate. Decision is the operators (D1).

Spec premise STALE: project-guidance.md is at 3499/3499 (100%), not +369 over -- discharged by commit d3e00680, which records +369 as a CRLF measurement artifact. No sweep performed. Own additions routed to the on-demand authoring guide so preload stayed green (94%). Admission-bar rule change is operator-held (D2).
Batched education-mode brief presented (D1 artifacts, D2 admission bar, D3 close backstop). Operator took all three defaults; journaled as three authority=human records with attestation.
Operator-directed: ship ai_router.session_checklist so every consumer repo renders step-level progress at transitional boundaries.
Full pytest + Layer 3 Playwright run of record after last code change.
Verification loop, change-log.md, Step 9 review, path-aware critique, disposition, close_session.
Shipped ai_router.session_checklist (plain/markdown/verbose), constitution Step 4 obligation, operator-notes record, 33 tests. Discharges the S3-recorded in-session visibility gap.
Full pytest + Layer 3 Playwright run of record, after the last code change.
Run of record after code freeze: pytest 3783 passed / 0 failed / 10 skipped; Layer 3 Playwright 33 passed (9.3m). Both recorded via run_of_record; freshness check green.
